title: Partial reproduction of published transliteration inventory counts
target_locator: Table 9, versions ZL3b and GC2a; inspected 2026-09-06
target_claim: ZL has 5,385 loci and 740 paragraphs; GC has 5,367 loci and 775 paragraphs.
agreement: All four targeted locus/paragraph counts match the source table. Page-unit difference is documented separately: GC has no f116v page record.
method: Original Python IVTFF parser, source-verified raw hashes, count unique locus/transcriber IDs and explicit paragraph-start markers; no reuse of IVTT code.
limitations: Partial relative to the complete source table: STA1 character counts and all native word-count conventions are not reconstructed.
This independently written parser was executed by the same AI-assisted launch effort; it is not independent human validation.
Matching counts do not validate glyph accuracy, image alignment or independence of shared page metadata.
scientific_consequence: Coverage and paragraph-marker invariants can catch accidental truncation and parser regressions before downstream analyses.
